changelog:
Initial release of crypto-tax-calculator.

- Calculates crypto capital gains and losses using FIFO cost-basis from a CSV of buy/sell transactions.
- Supports BTC, ETH, SOL, and any other tracked asset.
- Provides short-term vs long-term gain/loss breakdowns and per-asset summaries.
- Exports a Form 8949-style, lot-by-lot CSV report for tax filing preparation.
- Useful for reconciling realized gains at tax time, tracking tax exposure, and producing audit trails.
- Limitations: FIFO only, requires full buy history, does not handle wash sales or jurisdiction-specific rules.
